title: Nucleophagy removes cytotoxic trapped PARP1
authors: Hoslett G; Tribble S; Lascaux P; Koukouravas S; Torrecilla I; Song W; Hou C; Li J; González-Fernández M; Gregoriis GD; Dagg RA; O’Brien D; Pierangelini A; Ng AWT; Raimundo N; Milosevic I; Freire R; Li Y; Rottenberg S; Krastev DB; Lord CJ; Tarsounas M; Ramadan K
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PARP1在染色质上的捕获及其通过核自噬降解的细胞保护机制，属于细胞生物学与DNA损伤修复范畴，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Poly (ADP-Ribose) Polymerase inhibitors (PARPi) induce cytotoxicity in homologous recombination repair (HRR)-deficient cancers by causing PARP1 to become trapped on chromatin, resulting in irreparable replication-associated DNA damage. Although increased clearance of trapped PARP1 from chromatin reduces the sensitivity of cancer cells to PARPi, details surrounding this process remain unclear. PARPi exposure is known to cause increased autophagy flux, whilst autophagy inhibition can hypersensitise cells to PARPi. Using various biochemical, cell biological and live imaging-based assays, we found that trapped PARP1 is cleared by nucleophagy, the selective autophagy of nuclear substrates. Specifically, the nucleophagy of trapped PARP1 was orchestrated by the selective autophagy receptor TEX264 and its partner segregase p97/VCP. TEX264 mediates this process by directly interacting with trapped PARP1, thus bridging PARP1 to the autophagosomal resident protein LC3 for processing via autophagy. Impeding this process, either chemically or genetically, heightened PARP1 trapping, leading to accumulation of protein aggregates, replication-associated DNA damage and cell lethality, re-sensitising PARPi-resistant cells to various PARPi. In conclusion, we show that nucleophagy acts in a cytoprotective manner to directly target PARPi-induced trapped PARP1 for degradation.
abstract_zh: 聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶抑制剂（PARPi）通过使PARP1被困在染色质上，导致不可修复的复制相关DNA损伤，从而在同源重组修复（HRR）缺陷型癌症中诱导细胞毒性。尽管从染色质中清除被困PARP1的增加会降低癌细胞对PARPi的敏感性，但围绕这一过程的细节仍不清楚。已知PARPi暴露会导致自噬通量增加，而自噬抑制可使细胞对PARPi超敏化。利用多种生物化学、细胞生物学和活细胞成像检测方法，我们发现被困的PARP1通过核自噬（nucleophagy）被清除，即核底物的选择性自噬。具体而言，被困PARP1的核自噬由选择性自噬受体TEX264及其伴侣分离酶p97/VCP协调。TEX264通过直接与被困PARP1相互作用来介导这一过程，从而将PARP1桥接至自噬体驻留蛋白LC3，以便通过自噬进行处理。通过化学或遗传方式阻碍这一过程，会加剧PARP1的被困，导致蛋白质聚集体的积累、复制相关DNA损伤和细胞致死性，并使PARPi耐药细胞重新对多种PARPi敏感。总之，我们表明核自噬以细胞保护方式直接靶向PARPi诱导的被困PARP1进行降解。
